column1: # Outdated printed symbols in the signature lists -> current HGNC symbols (specs/signatures_spec.md §2).
# Built 2026-10-06 from the HGNC complete set (hgnc_complete_set.txt, storage.googleapis.com/public-download-files/hgnc,
#   for each printed symbol absent from the pair's bulk gene axis, the unique approved symbol listing it as a previous
#   symbol (else as an alias) that is on the bulk axis. Unresolved symbols (LOC/FLJ/clone ids, IG loci, none or several
#   candidates) are not listed: they are dropped when scoring and counted (genes listed / matched / used).
# Human pairs only; mouse symbols (Holtman, printed in capitals) are matched case-insensitively when scoring.
